title.purpose: Name, section headings, entry titles, button labels — 14px/500; headings never exceed body size.

body.purpose: All prose at 14px/400 with relaxed 1.625 leading.

label.purpose: Pill button text; body size, medium weight.

meta.purpose: Heatmap legend, tooltip, footnotes — the only 12px usage. Set in IBM Plex Mono.

mono.purpose: IBM Plex Mono 400 — the log-annotation register: dates, legend, summary, tooltip, footer, availability line.

shadows.name: pill-lift
shadows.purpose: Faint press under the two page-level pill buttons (shadow-sm).

shadows.name: tooltip-float
shadows.purpose: Elevation for the floating heatmap tooltip (shadow-lg).

shadows.name: star-glow
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode glow on star-field points — light, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Collapsible grid-row unfold and chevron rotation.

motion.name: star-fall
motion.purpose: Ambient falling stars; halved under 640px; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: star-twinkle
motion.purpose: Star opacity pulse; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: The page-level action (resume/cv); mist fill, ink label, faint lift, presses to 98%.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e5e5e5; color: #171717; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4d4d4; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Pill Button
components.description: The quiet companion action (get in touch); paper fill with a hairline ring instead of a tonal fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; color: #262626; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e5e5e5, 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fafafa; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d4d4d4, 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Prose Inline Link
components.description: Citation-style link inside paragraphs: hairline underline, hover darkens to ink.
components.css: .ds-prose { color: #525252; font: 400 14px/1.625 Inter, sans-serif; margin: 0; } .ds-link-inline { color: #404040; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #737373; text-decoration-thickness: 0.5px; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-link-inline:hover { color: #171717; }

components.name: Entry Title Link
components.description: Medium-weight row title for project/experiment/contact entries; underline at half opacity, darkens on group hover.
components.css: .ds-entry-link { color: #262626; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(163, 163, 163, 0.5); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-entry-link:hover { color: #171717; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Lowercase label led by a 14px stroke icon; stands 16px above its entries.
components.html: projects
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #262626; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-section-heading svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: #525252; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Heatmap Tooltip
components.description: Inverted floating tooltip for contribution cells; the only element with a large shadow.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; background: #262626; color: #f5f5f5; font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), inset 0 0 0 1px #404040; }

components.name: Entry Row
components.description: Shared row grammar for projects/experiments/certs/links: title, mono year, one-line description; crosses + hairline outline on hover and focus.
components.html: echod2026a lightweight, raft-inspired consensus protocol for heterogeneous edge devices.
components.css: .ds-entry-row { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 0; text-decoration: none; outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-entry-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -11.25px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; background-image: linear-gradient(#a3a3a3, #a3a3a3), linear-gradient(#a3a3a3, #a3a3a3), linear-gradient(#a3a3a3, #a3a3a3), linear-gradient(#a3a3a3, #a3a3a3); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 0.5px 10px, 10px 0.5px, 0.5px 10px, 10px 0.5px; background-position: left 4.75px top 0, left 0 top 4.75px, right 4.75px bottom 0, right 0 bottom 4.75px; } .ds-entry-row:hover::before, .ds-entry-row:focus-within::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-entry-row:hover, .ds-entry-row:focus-visible { outline: 0.5px solid rgba(163, 163, 163, 0.5); } .ds-entry-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-entry-title { color: #262626; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(163, 163, 163, 0.5); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-entry-row:hover .ds-entry-title { color: #171717; } .ds-entry-year { color: #525252; font: 400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-entry-desc { color: #525252; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a working engineer's log: dense lowercase entries, evidence-first content, hairline structure, and nothing decorative that isn't also information. One column, one ink, essentially one type size — the confidence of the design is that it never raises its voice. Recruiters scan a page that behaves like a well-kept notebook: name and location stamped at the top, entries grouped under small labeled headings, every claim a click away from its proof (a repo, an issuer page, a live contribution graph).

The atmosphere is quiet, dense, precise. Ornament is limited to two ambient gestures — a star field drifting behind the page, and small cross-marks that appear at an entry's corners on hover — both disabled for reduced motion and on touch devices. Dark mode is not an inversion but a second page stock: near-black paper, pale ink, and a barely-warm stone tint on the owner's name and inline links, like pencil under lamplight.

Confirmed anti-references: hero banners, gradients, marketing copy, and card grids. If a change moves the page toward any of those, it is moving away from the product.
keyCharacteristics: Single centered measure (576px) at every viewport — no grids, no cards
Monochrome neutral palette; hierarchy by ink tone, never by hue
Headings set at body size (14px); weight and tone carry structure
Capsule controls, hairline rings, flat surfaces; shadow reserved for floating elements
Lowercase, terse, technical voice in all copy
Motion as ambience (stars, 0.2s control transitions, 0.4s collapsibles) with full reduced-motion parity

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is no chromatic accent anywhere in the system — not for links, not for focus, not for the heatmap (a five-step gray ramp). Emphasis is always a darker or lighter step of the same neutral. If a design needs a "pop", it gets a tonal step, never a hue.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes are parallel stocks, not inversions. Dark-mode headings take a barely-warm stone tint (#f5f5f4 on the name, #d6d3d1 on prose links) — the only place the strict neutral ramp bends.

rules.name: The Same-Size Rule
rules.body: Headings render at body size (14px). Hierarchy is produced by weight (400 vs 500) and ink tone (fog → pencil → ink), never by scale. A new "bigger heading" is a design-system change, not a local decision.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: The system ships exactly two sizes: 14px for everything read, 12px for everything glanced (legend, tooltip). Do not introduce a third.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means "this floats": pills that act, a tooltip that hovers, stars that shine. Never add a shadow to a static surface; use a tonal step or a hairline instead.

rules.name: The Capsule-or-Square Rule
rules.body: Interactive = capsule, information = square. A radius between 6px and full (e.g. a 12px card corner) belongs to a card grid, which is an anti-reference; don't introduce one.

dos: Do keep all copy lowercase, terse, and technical — the voice is part of the identity.
Do build hierarchy from weight and ink tone (fog → pencil → ink); the Same-Size Rule is the system.
Do use hairline rings (1px tonal) instead of borders, and whitespace instead of dividers.
Do give every interactive element a keyboard path and a visible focus state — focus must look exactly like hover (cross-marks on `:focus-within`, hairline outline on `:focus-visible`).
Do honor reduced motion with full parity — disable the star field and transitions, never partially.
Do ship both themes together; every new custom rule needs an explicit dark variant, WCAG AA contrast included.
Do keep the two-size type scale (14px / 12px) and the two-weight subset (400/500).
donts: Don't add chromatic accents — no brand blue links, no colored badges, no syntax-highlight hues (One Ink Rule).
Don't introduce cards, card grids, hero banners, or gradients — confirmed anti-references.
Don't put shadows on static surfaces; shadow means floating (Flat-By-Default Rule).
Don't add a radius between 6px and full capsule (Capsule-or-Square Rule).

Don't add a third type size, a display role, or a third typeface — the system is Inter plus IBM Plex Mono for the meta register (owner-approved 2026-07-28); don't re-add Google Fonts — all faces are self-hosted on purpose.
Don't use borders where a hairline ring reads cleaner, or marketing copy anywhere — entries state facts and link their proof.
Don't enlarge text below AA on either paper; the muted tones (ash, fog) are for metadata and ornament, not body copy.
